name: Joshibiah
overview: Joshibiah was a male member of the tribe of Simeon, identified specifically as the son of Seraiah. His mention in Scripture is brief and primarily genealogical, highlighting his place within the Simeonite lineage. No additional personal notes or distinguishing actions are recorded.
namesAndTitles: The name Joshibiah means 'YHWH places,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's sovereignty. This proper name appears in 1 Chronicles 4:35 and was not given directly by God but carries a meaningful connection to the divine name.
familyAndRelationships: Joshibiah is explicitly recorded as the son of Seraiah, and it is inferred that Jehu is his father. Beyond these relationships, Scripture does not provide further family details, focusing mainly on his descent within the tribe of Simeon.
scriptureSignificance: Joshibiah's significance lies in his role within the genealogical records of the tribe of Simeon, as documented in 1 Chronicles 4. His mention helps to preserve the lineage and tribal heritage important to Israel's history. Though not a prominent figure in narrative events, his inclusion underscores the biblical emphasis on family lines and God's providential care in preserving His people.
